messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Can you think of any
weaknesses that bugs have?

{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Do you think they get
ticklish if you touch their
bellies?
{07 03 00}Ha! I'd like to see
{04 1a 00}
rolling around laughing!
{07 00 00}Say,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} wanna see
who can catch one first?{01 00 00 0a 00}
It's a race, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Whoever can get
{04 1a 00}
to laugh first wins!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kas sul tuleb meelde mõni
putukate nõrk koht?

{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Kas arvad, et neil hakkab
kõdi, kui neile kõhtu
puudutada?
{07 03 00}Ha! Tahaksin näha, kuidas
{04 1a 00}
naerdes ringi veereb!
{07 00 00}Kuule,{01 00 00 05 00} {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} tahad näha,
kes püüab esimesena?{01 00 00 0a 00}
Võidujooks, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}Kes paneb
{04 1a 00}
esimesena naerma, võidab!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Lately,{01 00 00 05 00} I've been doing
stretching exercises before
getting into the bathtub.
{07 14 00}When you're limber,{01 00 00 0a 00} you're
ready to strike on a
moment's notice.
{07 0b 00}But what about bugs?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 16 00} Their
bodies are so,{01 00 00 0a 00} uh, crunchy,
{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}I'd really worry about
{04 1a 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{01 01 00}
{07 0c 00}Oh! I've got an idea!
{07 14 00}Let's see who can nab
{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}
first!
{07 00 00}The first one to make
{04 1a 00} do
a split wins,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Viimasel ajal{01 00 00 05 00} olen teinud
venitusharjutusi enne
vanni minekut.
{07 14 00}Kui oled painduv,{01 00 00 0a 00} oled
valmis hetkega
lööma.
{07 0b 00}Aga putukad?{01 00 00 14 00}{07 16 00} Nende
kehad on nii,{01 00 00 0a 00} ee, krõbedad,
{04 02 00}.
{07 0e 00}Ma muretseksin väga
{04 1a 00} pärast.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00}{01 01 00}
{07 0c 00}Oh! Mul on mõte!
{07 14 00}Vaatame, kes napsab
{04 1a 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}
esimesena!
{07 00 00}Esimene, kes paneb
{04 1a 00} spagaati
tegema, võidab,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
